test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘Z + Q’ means ‘Z is the brother of Q’,

‘Z × Q’ means ‘Z is the father of Q’,

‘Z ÷ Q’ means ‘Z is the mother of Q’.

Which of the following would mean ‘A is the son of B’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 ÷ 
 × 
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Mother
 Father
 
 

 

Given: A is the son of B

Now, checking each option one by one,

Option 1): B × I × A → B is the father of I and I is the father of A 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e58f4d56ab92c2512ee7c90f48022a18e8a194cc4a465dce18bb93a3b602e24.png] → A is the grandson/granddaughter of B

Option 2): B + A × I → B is the brother of A and A is the father of I

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afb19407dfd5b9d1ea96dff2f5d30072a8579f34c1fdfdac2056864cc055b7d8.png] → A is the brother of B

Option 3): B ÷ A ÷ I → B is the mother of A and A is the mother of I

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e1f4c30b0032241fbc901c6ea104a1241172c3971b7a887e4fc5120859f84e3.png] → A is the daughter of B

**Option 4)**: B × A + I → B is the father of A and A is the brother of I

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af706197d698bac0f2fd5a4f9bd42962d3b74193fd71eadf3477df34a67990f5.png] → A is the **son** of B

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (4)".**
